inspection_summary: Inspected all 1,726 logical lines. The paper develops a conjectural divisor-correlation route to arbitrary-length shifted zeta moments, stratifies off-diagonal tuples by rational directions, and then proves local Euler-factor identities showing that the resulting all-nonzero and partially zero shift strata match the recipe's swap terms. Formula extraction is imperfect but the selected mechanisms are recoverable from checked prose and adjacent displayed formulas; exact formula reuse should be verified against the retained original.

sections_inspected.label: Front matter and abstract
sections_inspected.mathematical_role: States the Type II/circle-method objective and claimed recovery of all lower-order terms.

sections_inspected.label: 1. Introduction
sections_inspected.mathematical_role: Places Type II off-diagonal terms in the long-Dirichlet-polynomial moment program and identifies the multidimensional circle-method viewpoint.

sections_inspected.label: 2. Shifted moments
sections_inspected.mathematical_role: Defines shifted divisor coefficients, pole-subtracted truncations, swap terms, the length-dependent swap cutoff, and the convolution partition of the mean square.

sections_inspected.label: 3. Type II convolution sums
sections_inspected.mathematical_role: Introduces rational-direction strata, the coupled product constraint, refined convolution sums, their multiplicity weight, and the main conjectural comparison.

sections_inspected.label: 4. The case where all h_j are nonzero
sections_inspected.mathematical_role: Applies the delta-method average, rescales discrepancies, inserts a Perron cutoff, and states the global identity linking the analytic expression to full swap terms.

sections_inspected.label: 5. Preliminary reductions
sections_inspected.mathematical_role: Evaluates the sign-summed Fourier integrals by contour rotation and gamma factors.

sections_inspected.label: 6. Poles
sections_inspected.mathematical_role: Extracts shifted-divisor residues, records cancellation of truncation-pole terms, uses the zeta functional equation, and reduces the global identity to an Euler-product identity.

sections_inspected.label: 7. Local considerations
sections_inspected.mathematical_role: Translates the target to formal power series at one prime and proves it through telescoping, convolution, and inclusion-exclusion lemmas.

sections_inspected.label: 8. Terms with some h_j zero
sections_inspected.mathematical_role: Separates exact rational directions, reduces the active delta-method dimension, and states the identity for lower-cardinality swap strata.

sections_inspected.label: 9. Preliminary reductions, again
sections_inspected.mathematical_role: Reuses the earlier Fourier-integral reduction for the lower-dimensional active stratum.

sections_inspected.label: 10. Poles, again
sections_inspected.mathematical_role: Performs the mixed active/diagonal residue calculation and reduces it to a hybrid Euler-factor identity.

sections_inspected.label: 11. Local considerations, again
sections_inspected.mathematical_role: Proves the hybrid local identity by adjoining the diagonal factors to the earlier convolution and inclusion-exclusion mechanism.

sections_inspected.label: 12. Multiplicities and conclusion
sections_inspected.mathematical_role: Shows that partition overcounting equals representation-system overcounting and summarizes the stratum-to-swap correspondence.

sections_inspected.label: References and author back matter
sections_inspected.mathematical_role: Bibliographic and affiliation material; inspected and excluded from semantic units.

accepted_units.title: Type II off-diagonal terms as a multidimensional circle-method problem
accepted_units.why_material: Defines the paper's reusable strategic reframing: moments of long Dirichlet polynomials require systematic treatment of Type II off-diagonal terms, viewed as a multidimensional Hardy-Littlewood circle method.
accepted_units.context_note: Includes the abstract and the introduction's contrast with earlier Type I and special Type II cases.
accepted_units.representation_dependency: Prose-grounded; the notation zeta(s)^k and the long-polynomial setting are legible in the text layer.

accepted_units.title: Pole-subtracted long Dirichlet polynomials for shifted moments
accepted_units.why_material: Defines the shifted coefficient family tau_A, the smoothed moment, Perron truncation, and residue subtraction that lets a finite polynomial represent the intended shifted-zeta average at large length.
accepted_units.context_note: The expectation X>T^k is part of the setup, not a proved asymptotic here.
accepted_units.representation_dependency: Several displayed formulas are required; their structure is recoverable, but exact transcription should be checked against the PDF.

accepted_units.title: Recipe terms encoded as equal-cardinality signed swaps
accepted_units.why_material: Turns the moment recipe into a combinatorial transformation on shift sets: remove equal-sized subsets, negate them across the two sides, and track the resulting arithmetic factor.
accepted_units.context_note: The w,z contour representation supplies the bridge from truncated polynomials to the shifted recipe.
accepted_units.representation_dependency: Depends on set operations such as A-U+V^- and on a formula-dense contour display; prose explicitly defines the swap semantics.

accepted_units.title: Dirichlet-polynomial length selects the maximum swap depth
accepted_units.why_material: Shows how the factor (X/T^{|U|})^{w+z} suppresses terms beyond a threshold, so T^ell<=X<T^{ell+1} determines which swap cardinalities survive.
accepted_units.context_note: Also locates the arbitrary-swap case relative to the earlier zero-, one-, and two-swap analyses.
accepted_units.representation_dependency: The contour-shift argument depends on the displayed scaling factor but is clearly explained in prose.

accepted_units.title: Convolution partition of the off-diagonal mean square
accepted_units.why_material: Expands the smoothed mean square term-by-term, decomposes tau_A and tau_B into ell convolutions, and explains why ordered pairings of the component sets become relevant.
accepted_units.context_note: This is the entry point for the second, divisor-correlation derivation.
accepted_units.representation_dependency: Requires the Fourier transform and convolution displays; exact normalization is formula-dependent.

accepted_units.title: Rational-direction stratification prevents missing delta-method main terms
accepted_units.why_material: Identifies the central obstruction to a naive delta-method application: solutions must be stratified by rational directions M_j/N_j under a coupled product constraint, with discrepancies h_j measuring distance from each direction.
accepted_units.context_note: The Manin-style subvariety analogy motivates separate counting without asserting a general theorem about such varieties.
accepted_units.representation_dependency: The product constraint and h_j=m_jN_j-n_jM_j are essential; the logarithmic approximation is formula-dependent.

accepted_units.title: Refined Type II sum and weighted partition conjecture
accepted_units.why_material: Defines the rationally stratified sum O^dagger, averages it over decompositions with a later-justified weight, and states that this reconstructs the pole-subtracted shifted moment up to power saving.
accepted_units.context_note: The paper supplies evidence through a conjectural delta-method replacement followed by a rigorous identity of the resulting expression.
accepted_units.representation_dependency: Formula-heavy definition; the prose makes the logical status and role of the weight explicit.

accepted_units.title: Delta-method averaging with all discrepancies nonzero
accepted_units.why_material: Replaces coupled shifted-divisor sums by local averages expressed through Ramanujan sums and additive twists, converting discrete correlation data into contour integrals over continuous size variables.
accepted_units.context_note: This replacement is conjectural; integer direction and discrepancy variables remain discrete.
accepted_units.representation_dependency: Strong dependence on displayed additive-twist Dirichlet series; selected because the surrounding prose recovers the transformation.

accepted_units.title: Rescaling discrepancies and enforcing the product range by Perron inversion
accepted_units.why_material: The variables v_j=T|h_j|/(2pi u_jN_j) isolate the oscillatory scale, while a Perron integral detects the coupled product bound and gathers the result into the common LHS_ell expression.
accepted_units.context_note: Signs of h_j are retained as epsilon_j and summed explicitly.
accepted_units.representation_dependency: Highly formula-dependent; conceptual roles of the rescaling and Perron detector are explicit in prose.

accepted_units.title: Theorem 1: analytic Type II expression equals the ell-swap recipe contribution
accepted_units.why_material: States the key rigorous identity that identifies the transformed all-nonzero correlation expression with recipe terms choosing one shifted element from every paired block.
accepted_units.context_note: The theorem applies to the expression obtained after the conjectural correlation replacement; it does not make that replacement rigorous.
accepted_units.representation_dependency: The exact B-factor and shifted-set formula require scan verification, while the one-per-block selection rule is clear.

accepted_units.title: Sign-summed Fourier integrals collapse through contour rotation
accepted_units.why_material: Generalizes the one-dimensional Fourier identity by integrating variables from the inside out, rotating positive and negative sign contours, and producing gamma/chi factors.
accepted_units.context_note: This lemma is the analytic simplifier used before residue and Euler-product comparison.
accepted_units.representation_dependency: The target identity is display-dependent; the proof mechanism is well supported by prose.

accepted_units.title: Shift poles cancel truncation residues and trigger the zeta functional equation
accepted_units.why_material: Expands additive-twist averages at poles near one, sums discrepancies into zeta factors, identifies residues that cancel the earlier R_A,R_B subtraction, and then converts remaining factors with the functional equation.
accepted_units.context_note: Separates the conjectural average formula from the subsequent exact symbolic reduction.
accepted_units.representation_dependency: Euler factors and residue locations are formula-sensitive; the cancellation and functional-equation sequence is explicit.

accepted_units.title: Global identity reduced to a primewise Euler-factor identity
accepted_units.why_material: Reorganizes the transformed integrand so equality with the recipe is reduced, for each chosen swap, to equality of two Euler products.
accepted_units.context_note: This is the handoff from analytic transforms to formal local algebra.
accepted_units.representation_dependency: Depends on the displayed product identity and shifted-set notation; exact exponents should be scan-checked.

accepted_units.title: Formal power-series encoding and Theorem 2
accepted_units.why_material: Suppresses the prime and divisor notation to work in X=1/p, introduces cumulative coefficient identities and C(A,B), and states the local identity whose right side is precisely a swapped Euler factor.
accepted_units.context_note: Theorem 1 follows after specified substitutions into Theorem 2.
accepted_units.representation_dependency: Relies on formal-series notation A(n), Z(A), C(A,B), and a dense definition of Sigma.

accepted_units.title: Three local lemmas separate boundary kernels, convolution, and inclusion-exclusion
accepted_units.why_material: Decomposes Theorem 2 into explicit formulas for Sigma(M,0) and Sigma(0,N), a diagonal convolution identity F=C, and an inclusion-exclusion expansion of the swapped Euler factor.
accepted_units.context_note: This supplies a modular proof plan rather than treating the primewise identity as an opaque calculation.
accepted_units.representation_dependency: Exact lemma statements are formula-dependent but their division of labor is clear.

accepted_units.title: Assembly of the local identity from the three lemmas
accepted_units.why_material: Shows that expanding each local Sigma term yields the same disjoint-subset inclusion-exclusion expression as the swapped Euler factor.
accepted_units.context_note: The extraction appears to misnumber cited lemmas in the prose, but the displayed proof chain and endpoint remain recoverable.
accepted_units.representation_dependency: Depends on the signed subset sum and product display; original scan should resolve lemma-number typography.

accepted_units.title: Boundary splitting makes the local Sigma kernel telescope
accepted_units.why_material: Splits the d-sum at d=M, telescopes the finite and infinite pieces, recognizes a convolution, and obtains the three-term boundary formula, with the N case by symmetry.
accepted_units.context_note: Retains the full mechanism because the split-and-cancel step explains why the local kernel has the form used later.
accepted_units.representation_dependency: Long algebraic displays carry exact shifts and exponents; prose reliably exposes split, telescope, cancellation, and symmetry.

accepted_units.title: Diagonal convolution identity via the minimum of paired indices
accepted_units.why_material: Proves F=C for arbitrary coefficient sequences by Fourier-enforcing equal totals and uniquely decomposing each pair (R,S) by K=min(R,S).
accepted_units.context_note: This is a reusable bijective explanation of the min(M,N)=0 parametrization, not merely a divisor-function calculation.
accepted_units.representation_dependency: Uses generating functions and a theta integral; the minimum decomposition is prose-grounded.

accepted_units.title: Local swapped product expands over disjoint subset choices
accepted_units.why_material: Applies a one-pair three-term identity independently across blocks and integrates equal total degree, yielding the signed sum over disjoint choices J1,J2.
accepted_units.context_note: This proves the inclusion-exclusion lemma that closes Theorem 2.
accepted_units.representation_dependency: Formula-dependent product expansion; the independent-per-block choice structure is clear.

accepted_units.title: Zero discrepancies become exact rational directions and lower the active dimension
accepted_units.why_material: When h_j=0, coprimality forces m_j=kappa_jM_j and n_j=kappa_jN_j; factoring these exact directions changes the length cutoff and leaves a lower-dimensional nonzero correlation problem.
accepted_units.context_note: This is a distinct boundary stratum, not a negligible special case.
accepted_units.representation_dependency: The factorized X' and remaining convolution display are required; the reduction is explicit in prose.

accepted_units.title: Mixed-stratum Perron expression and Theorem 3
accepted_units.why_material: Repeats the rescaling only for active discrepancies, carries diagonal kappa factors separately, and states that the residue at the auxiliary cutoff variable equals the ell-prime swap contribution.
accepted_units.context_note: U and V select one element only from the active blocks, explaining lower-cardinality swaps.
accepted_units.representation_dependency: Dense two-variable contour formula with minor extraction ambiguity; theorem role and selection rule are recoverable.

accepted_units.title: Active poles plus diagonal factors reduce to a hybrid local identity
accepted_units.why_material: Combines the earlier pole/functional-equation mechanism on active blocks with untouched diagonal divisor factors, then reduces the residue at s'=0 to an Euler-product equality.
accepted_units.context_note: This is the analytic bridge required before proving the mixed local theorem.
accepted_units.representation_dependency: Highly formula-dependent; extracted primes on ell and contour variables should be verified in the scan.

accepted_units.title: Theorem 4: hybrid Euler factor for active and diagonal blocks
accepted_units.why_material: States the local identity that combines Sigma factors for active blocks with ordinary shifted-divisor coefficients for zero-discrepancy blocks, producing the corresponding partial-swap Euler factor.
accepted_units.context_note: Explicit substitutions show how Theorem 4 implies Theorem 3.
accepted_units.representation_dependency: The Q-prime definition is display-heavy but the active-versus-diagonal factorization is clear.

accepted_units.title: Earlier local lemmas extend to the hybrid identity
accepted_units.why_material: Substitutes the boundary Sigma formula, then uses the same convolution and inclusion-exclusion identities with all blocks in C but only active blocks in the swap factors.
accepted_units.context_note: Documents exactly what changes and what is reused from the all-nonzero proof.
accepted_units.representation_dependency: Requires careful reading of ell versus ell-prime indices; conceptual transfer is prose-supported.

accepted_units.title: Every fixed ell-swap is repeated by block decompositions with one marked element each
accepted_units.why_material: Counts the decompositions realizing a fixed swap: unmarked elements choose blocks independently and block orderings contribute factorials, producing ell!^2 ell^{2(k-ell)}.
accepted_units.context_note: Explains the weight introduced in the refined sum.
accepted_units.representation_dependency: Combinatorial prose is sufficient; only the final multiplicity formula is symbolic.

accepted_units.title: The same multiplicity counts representations by direction-discrepancy systems
accepted_units.why_material: Shows that redistributing unused divisor factors and ordering distinguished factors produces exactly the same multiplicity for each underlying (m,n), including strata with zero discrepancies.
accepted_units.context_note: Equality of the two overcount counts justifies division by the common weight.
accepted_units.representation_dependency: The extracted starred and hatted variables are somewhat degraded, but the construction and count are recoverable from prose.

accepted_units.title: All discrepancy strata collectively reproduce all surviving swap terms
accepted_units.why_material: Summarizes the causal correspondence: all nonzero h_j give ell swaps, exactly ell-prime nonzero h_j give ell-prime swaps, and summing weighted partitions makes the delta-method and recipe evaluations agree.
accepted_units.context_note: The agreement remains conditional on the conjectural shifted-divisor average, while the Euler-product identifications are rigorous.
accepted_units.representation_dependency: Prose-grounded summary with a small convolution display.

within_source_synthesis_candidates.title: Polynomial length as a semantic depth selector
within_source_synthesis_candidates.claim: The analytic length X does more than control error: after contour shifting it selects the maximum cardinality of the shift-set transformation that the correlation model must reproduce.
within_source_synthesis_candidates.limit: Established within this recipe and contour setup; it is not a general theorem that truncation length always measures conceptual depth.

within_source_synthesis_candidates.title: Rational-direction strata are the missing bridge from correlations to swaps
within_source_synthesis_candidates.claim: Convolution exposes paired ratios, rational-direction stratification prevents the delta method from losing main terms, and the transformed strata are identified with recipe swaps.
within_source_synthesis_candidates.limit: The identification theorem applies after a conjectural average replacement, so it validates the bridge's algebra rather than proving the original correlation asymptotic.

within_source_synthesis_candidates.title: Global analytic matching is certified by local combinatorial algebra
within_source_synthesis_candidates.claim: Residues and the functional equation reduce the comparison to one prime, where minimum-index decomposition and inclusion-exclusion reconstruct the swapped Euler factor.
within_source_synthesis_candidates.limit: This synthesis concerns equality of the resulting Euler products and does not remove the upstream delta-method conjecture.

within_source_synthesis_candidates.title: Boundary strata recursively encode lower swap cardinalities
within_source_synthesis_candidates.claim: Setting some discrepancies to zero forces exact rational parametrizations, leaves a smaller active correlation problem, and yields swaps only from active blocks while diagonal blocks persist in the Euler factor.
within_source_synthesis_candidates.limit: The recursion is source-specific and formula extraction around ell versus ell-prime should be scan-verified before exact reuse.

within_source_synthesis_candidates.title: Matching overcounts close the two representations
within_source_synthesis_candidates.claim: The same factor counts how often a fixed swap appears across block partitions and how often an underlying term appears across direction-discrepancy systems, so dividing by it aligns the two global enumerations.
within_source_synthesis_candidates.limit: This is an accounting equivalence within the chosen decompositions, not independent evidence for the conjectural correlation estimates.
